# shared execution

<a id="flow_d814e61191d1"></a>
## shared

Alpha, beta or the registered relay callback enter the shared function. Await jobs publication, then return input. The jobs consumer is an asynchronous possibility.

Evidence: [src_d814e61191d1], [src_612d754ef27e], [src_4ddb4d12e6e6], [src_71f7c4e13703], [src_25caa77b46f4].
